findings.issue: gradeDecision does not check that equityPct, requiredEquityPct or equityVsCallingRangePct are finite. If one is NaN, tenths() gives NaN, every comparison is false, so the result is grade 'minor' with marginPts NaN. When hand records are saved later (JSON), NaN becomes null, so the saved record would not match the in-memory GradeResult. An undefined equityPct on a hand-built object behaves the same way. The grade is quietly downgraded rather than rejected.
findings.evidence: No untrusted path today: through gradeView, every value comes from recommend() → toPct(), which always returns finite numbers. Only code that builds a recommendation by hand and calls gradeDecision directly (tests, a future range model plugged in through the PostflopOptions.equity seam) can pass NaN. In-process only, no attacker input.
findings.fix: Optional: in the equity branch, throw RangeError if any percent used is not Number.isFinite (fail closed, like the existing impossible-pair check), and add one unit test for it.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. REQ-025: gradeView takes only a PlayerView (a copied, field-by-field projection with no deck and no opponent hole cards) plus RecommendOptions (chart / equity function seams that already existed). grade.ts imports nothing from engine state, and the acceptance test checks that permuting hidden cards does not change the grade. GradeResult holds grade, ruleId, userAction, marginPts and the recommendation object passed in. PreflopRecommendation and PostflopRecommendation contain only the hero's own hand class, chart cell, legal move and summary equity numbers: no opponent cards, no later board cards, and no functions. A JSON round-trip test covers this. Malformed inputs: impossible action pairings and illegal or out-of-turn user actions throw RangeError (gradeView checks legalActions, which is empty when the seat is not to act). The one gap, non-finite percents, is reachable only from trusted in-process callers and is MINOR. No new dependencies, I/O, randomness, secrets or injection sinks.
